description: This file defines a PHP class 'SugarWidgetSubPanelSendInvitesButton' that extends another class 'SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton' to create a custom button in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM subpanel. The class includes a method 'display' that generates an HTML button for sending invites via email for a specific record.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelSendInvitesButton
classes.description: A class that creates a button to send invite emails from a subpanel in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML for a button that, when clicked, navigates to the sendinvitemails action for the current record.
